sender.en: A “buyer” on Facebook, Marketplace or chat

name.en: Fake proof of payment sent to online sellers

how.en: A buyer orders from your online shop and sends a screenshot of a bank or e-wallet transfer with a reference number and amount, sometimes made with AI. They book their own delivery rider and push you to hand over the goods right away. The money never arrives. Some repeat small orders first to build trust, then place big ones.

text.en: A buyer orders and sends a screenshot as proof of payment.
The receipt shows a reference number and amount but the money is not in your account.
They rush you to release the item to their own rider.
Orders grow bigger once you trust them.
Paid already via InstaPay, here is the screenshot with the ref no. My rider will pick up in 10 mins, please have the 4 tires ready, I need them today.

If you were cheated, keep the chats and receipts and report to the PNP-ACG.
